tables.label: TABLE 1
tables.caption: MICs of carbapenems and Hs02 and MBCs of Hs02 against K. pneumoniae, E. coli with various carbapenemase types and STsa,b,c
footnotes: MEM, meropenem; IPM, imipenem; ETP, ertapenem; S, susceptible; R, resistant.
Breakpoints (S–R): MEM (1–4 µg/mL), IPM (1–4 µg/mL), ETP (0.5–2 µg/mL).

The corresponding µM for µg/mL: MEM (4 µg/mL = 10.4 µM, 8 µg/mL = 20.8 µM, 16 µg/mL = 41.7 µM, etc); IPM (4 µg/mL = 13.3 µM, 8 µg/mL = 26.7 µM, 16 µg/mL = 53.4 µM, etc); ETP (4 µg/mL = 7.7 µM, 8 µg/mL = 15.4 µM, 16 µg/mL = 30.8 µM, etc).
